xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2102-42-49" status="unreviewed">'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs>s grags pa dngos po'i cha dpog kho na 'dod kyi rtag pa'i cha dpog sun dbyin te rtag pa tsam gyis dbul 'phongs pa su yang med pas log shes su grags pa rnams kyang tshad mar thal lo zhes [(p.318)]<lb n="318.1"/> brjod la|_<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">jo btsun</rs> ni rtag pa'i cha dpog kho na 'dod kyi cha dpog sun dbyin te dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rjes dpag dang khyad par med par thal lo zhes brjod kyang ldog pa gzhan gyi sgo nas de dag la khyad par yod pas nyes pa de dag kyang med la tshul gsum yang tshang bas gnyis ka yang dag gi rtags yin gyi gang rung zhig ma yin no||</seg></TEI>
